name: In Other Words
thesis: Monumental lavender name lettering opens a midnight-purple personal publication. Four precise typographic reels turn MAKE into CODE, SHOW, or HELP, introducing the different ways Raygen builds things.
interaction: Choose hands, code, teaching, or together to roll each letter into a new word and reveal a related story. The name responds with a restrained typographic shift. Tabs support arrow keys, Home, and End, with direct links into the full stories.
why: Evolves Lettershift through finished type and deliberate motion, pairs it with the purple atmosphere of My Little Corner, and gives real space to software, One Stone teaching, VEX shop leadership, Outpost support, and a personal closing letter. Actual Monstrosity, SERV0, DAVID, Stardance, and Outpost artwork anchor the content.
